heading: From Infrastructure to
paragraph1: With over 5 years of IT experience, I built my career moving through infrastructure, automation, and software development. I started out administering servers, networks, and corporate environments, and today I work as a full stack developer, building applications used in real business processes.
paragraph2: That path lets me see development beyond the code itself. I work with React, Node.js, Python, databases, and APIs, while applying my previous experience with servers, Linux, Docker, and automation to also think about deployment, integration, security, and reliability.
